title: Monetization and sustainability
goal: Sustainability hypotheses, ethical guardrails and consent-based partner interest capture.
acceptanceCriteria: The product makes no payment calls and stores no payment-card/banking data; core student discovery is proposed to remain free, and interest capture validates possible payer models.
